answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the economy binds identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each entity stakes a verifiable legacy credential—a tamper-proof relic of hardware execution. Staking fees scale superlinearly: while a lone whisper of computation requires negligible collateral, orchestrating swarms demands exponential capital exhaustion, making massive synthetic coordination prohibitively expensive even for a poetic sonnet generator.
